title: The Sinking Mother
text: A woman stands waist-deep in the black water, her arms held out, humming a lullaby you almost know. The water around her does not ripple. She is looking at the most tired of you as if she has been waiting for them all her life, and she is so very patient.

options.label: Let them go to her, if her arms are what they need.

outcomes.text: She holds them under, gently, a long time. What climbs out is green and dripping and still knows your names.
She kisses their brow and is gone. They come back calmer, holding something she gave them, and will not let anyone else touch it.
She will not let go, and the water is very cold, and very deep.

options.label: Walk on, eyes front. No mother waits in water like that.

outcomes.text: The humming follows you a while and then stops. The Leader does not stop hearing it, and walks into the next fight half in a dream.
The humming follows you all day, and some of you find yourselves humming along.

options.label: The Minstrel hums her tune back to her, gently, as a child might.

outcomes.text: She stops, and listens, and sinks out of sight smiling. The tune is the Minstrel's now, and it has power in it.
She stops, and listens, and takes the Minstrel's voice down into the water with her.
